trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode for dashboard workload
trello.desc: Raj to investigate connection contention issues causing dashboard slowness for accounts with many projects. Set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern and compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer in transaction mode against the current Postgres setup. Bring the benchmark numbers to the next product sync. Note: team has decided to stay on Postgres; no MongoDB migration or evaluation is in scope.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Tom to fix the typo in the onboarding email subject line ("recieve" should be "receive"). Push the fix through the email template repo today and get the updated template re-approved.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc to move dark mode under September design-system upgrade
trello.desc: Tom to update the roadmap document: dark mode is no longer listed under "Q3 committed" as a standalone item. Move it under the September design-system upgrade line, since theming (tokens, dark palette) ships as part of that upgrade. This ensures sales stops promising dark mode as a standalone deliverable. Update the doc right after the meeting.
